command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_dem3d_contact_impact.py tests/test_dem3d_contact_impact_convention.py tests/test_contact_impact_dashpot_convention.py tests/test_ice_thermal_stress_coupling.py -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Clamped head-on collision of two equal spheres with restitution 0.35, relative speed 1 m/s, general center velocity and non-axial orientation in the lab. Independent compression work is initial relative kinetic energy minus peak spring energy. Rebound work equals peak spring energy minus rebound kinetic energy and spring storage at force release. All errors normalized by initial relative kinetic energy. Time-step scales are 0.4, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05 and 0.025.
